items.title: Carter Benny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I certainly think that Gunther does it well, exceptionally well, really.

ctx.x: And the critics analyze what you do, and that’s . . .
Yeah. Yeah, you know, that’s their job, and for the most part, they do it well. I certainly think that Gunther does it well, exceptionally well, really.

While we’re on the subject of criticism, you had brought up before we started the interview today a recent piece in I guess it was Jazz Times or Down Beat, the blindfold test with Lee Conants [phonetic].
